canonical_name: c-cmaes -- Nikolaus Hansen's C reference implementation of CMA-ES
lineage: CMA-ES (1996-, Hansen & Ostermeier): evolution strategy with covariance matrix adaptation and cumulative step-size adaptation; this is the author's own ANSI C code (cmaes.c), the ancestor of every pycma-style port
version: github.com/CMA-ES/c-cmaes default branch as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

license.spdx: custom permissive (Hansen: 'may be used, modified, redistributed' with notice)

entry_points: ./evo1 (example1.c: optimise a test function from cmaes_initials.par)

example.output: iteration log and the best-ever solution

upstream_docs: Hansen, The CMA Evolution Strategy: A Tutorial, arXiv:1604.00772

human_capability_summary.built_to: minimise a black-box, possibly noisy and ill-conditioned objective in continuous space without derivatives
human_capability_summary.pressure: non-separable, badly scaled landscapes where gradient methods fail or are unavailable
human_capability_summary.success_means: reaching the optimum's function value within tolerance in a small multiple of the dimension's evaluations

known_human_problem_solved: derivative-free continuous optimisation with learned search-distribution geometry
